description:
SIXGEN’s mission is to deliver agile, mission-ready cybersecurity solutions that empower government and critical infrastructure organizations to stay ahead of advanced cyber threats. We combine innovation, deep expertise, and cutting-edge capabilities to uncover vulnerabilities, protect vital systems, and ensure operational superiority in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

 Position: Mobile Application Reverse Engineer 
Job Type: Full-time 
Location: Sterling, VA (Hybrid) 
Clearance Requirements: Must be a U.S. Citizen. Active TS clearance required. 
Experience: 5 + years

 Salary: $175-$225K

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 We are seeking a skilled and motivated Mobile Application Reverse Engineer to join our cybersecurity research team supporting mission-critical federal programs. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Android and iOS application analysis, reverse engineering, and mobile security research, with the ability to uncover vulnerabilities, analyze custom protocols, and assess the security of complex mobile applications.

 This role requires a curious and highly technical professional who enjoys exploring unfamiliar technologies, solving challenging problems, and developing innovative solutions to support customer missions.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 Mobile Application Analysis

 
 Perform static and dynamic analysis of Android and iOS mobile applications.

 Reverse engineer mobile applications and custom communication protocols.

 Analyze application behavior, security controls, and implementation details.

 Assess mobile applications for vulnerabilities and security weaknesses.

 
 Reverse Engineering & Research

 
 Utilize industry-standard reverse engineering tools and techniques to analyze mobile software.

 Investigate application artifacts, device storage, and forensic evidence left behind by mobile applications.

 Analyze network communications and packet captures to understand application behavior and identify security risks.

 Research emerging mobile technologies, attack techniques, and security challenges.

 
 Development & Collaboration

 
 Develop custom tools, scripts, and automation to support analysis and research efforts.

 Collaborate with teammates to solve complex technical problems and develop novel approaches.

 Document findings through clear and detailed technical reporting.

 Contribute across projects and support adjacent cybersecurity research initiatives as needed.

 
 QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).

 Experience performing Android and/or iOS reverse engineering and mobile application security assessments.

 Experience with reverse engineering tools such as jadx, Frida, Objection, apktool, Hopper, Ghidra, or similar platforms.

 Understanding of Android and iOS operating systems, application architecture, and security controls.

 Experience with rooting, jailbreaking, device emulation, or mobile testing environments.

 Familiarity with Android Debug Bridge (ADB), Xcode, and mobile debugging techniques.

 Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, packet analysis, and network security concepts.

 Understanding of modern cryptographic principles and secure communications.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 
 Experience developing software or automation using Python and/or C.

 Experience with Wireshark, mitmproxy, or network traffic interception techniques.

 Familiarity with Android obfuscation techniques such as ProGuard.

 Previous Android or iOS application development experience.

 Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading technical initiatives.

 Experience supporting federal, intelligence community, or national security missions.

 
 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS 

 At SIXGEN, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Compensation for this role will be based on experience, qualifications, technical expertise, and overall alignment with the position.

 Additionally, SIXGEN offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 
 Employer-paid health insurance premiums (medical, dental, vision) for you and your family 

 Employer-paid short/long term disability insurance and basic life/AD&D insurance

 401K with a 4% employer contribution

 Professional development reimbursement options available (training, certification, education, etc)​

 Flexible and remote work policies for most positions

 Flexible PTO and holiday schedule

 
 For more information, please reach out to our Director of Human Resources, Amy Maxwell at  amy.maxwell@sixgen.io .

 OUR COMMITMENT 

 SIXGEN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We ensure that all applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, marital status, ancestry, projected veteran status, or any other protected group or class.

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that values diversity in our people, reflecting the communities we serve and our customer base. We strive to attract and retain a diverse talent pool and create an environment where everyone is empowered to be their authentic selves at work.
